import csv
from decimal import Decimal

# Define the invoice data extracted from PDFs
invoices_data = {
    '003071': {
        'vendor': 'Grove Office Supply',
        'items': [
            ('Archive cartons, reinforced - batch 3', '10', '12.45', '124.50'),
            ('Labels "Handle with care", roll 3', '3', '11.80', '35.40'),
            ('Cut-to-length protective liner, grade 3', '2.5', '14.76', '36.90'),
            ('Returned labels credit, order 3', '1', '-9.80', '-9.80'),
        ],
        'tax': '23.17',
        'total': '210.17'
    },
    '003082': {
        'vendor': 'Harbor Workshop Ltd',
        'items': [
            ('Bench assembly, series 3', '2', '1279.60', '2559.20'),
            ('Alignment service, station 3', '1.5', '86.40', '129.60'),
            ('Replacement seal kit for hydraulic assembly, series 3, including mounting collars and protective sleeves; compatible with the extended housing and supplied with inspection certificate', '3', '50.75', '152.25'),
            ('Precision shims, pack 3', '7', '4.375', '30.63'),
            ('Freight and handling, zone 3', '1', '42.50', '42.50'),
            ('Volume discount, agreement 3', '1', '-37.00', '-37.00'),
        ],
        'tax': '155.28',
        'total': '3032.46'
    },
    '003093': {
        'vendor': 'Iris Field Services',
        'items': [
            ('Site survey, area 3', '1', '471.50', '471.50'),
            ('Travel time, route 3', '2.25', '64.80', '145.80'),
            ('Calibration standard, set 3', '2', '37.25', '74.50'),
            ('Additional sensor mounts, revised scope 3', '4', '18.95', '75.80'),
            ('Cable assemblies, shielded, length 3 m', '5', '11.40', '57.00'),
            ('Previously billed visit credit, ticket 3', '1', '-27.00', '-27.00'),
        ],
        'tax': '91.64',
        'total': '889.25'
    }
}

# Write items.csv
with open('items.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'vendor', 'description', 'quantity', 'unit_price', 'line_amount'])
    
    for invoice_id, invoice in invoices_data.items():
        vendor = invoice['vendor']
        for item in invoice['items']:
            description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount = item
            writer.writerow([invoice_id, vendor, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount])

# Calculate reconciliation
reconciliation = []
for invoice_id, invoice in invoices_data.items():
    # Sum line amounts
    subtotal = sum(Decimal(item[3]) for item in invoice['items'])
    tax = Decimal(invoice['tax'])
    printed_total = Decimal(invoice['total'])
    computed_total = subtotal + tax
    difference = computed_total - printed_total
    
    status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'
    
    reconciliation.append({
        'invoice_id': invoice_id,
        'subtotal': f'{subtotal:.2f}',
        'tax': f'{tax:.2f}',
        'printed_total': f'{printed_total:.2f}',
        'computed_total': f'{computed_total:.2f}',
        'difference': f'{difference:.2f}',
        'status': status
    })

# Write reconciliation.csv
with open('reconciliation.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['invoice_id', 'subtotal', 'tax', 'printed_total', 'computed_total', 'difference', 'status'])
    
    for rec in reconciliation:
        writer.writerow([
            rec['invoice_id'],
            rec['subtotal'],
            rec['tax'],
            rec['printed_total'],
            rec['computed_total'],
            rec['difference'],
            rec['status']
        ])

# Print summary
print("Processing complete!")
print("\nReconciliation Summary:")
for rec in reconciliation:
    print(f"Invoice {rec['invoice_id']}: {rec['status']}")
    if rec['status'] == 'discrepancy':
        print(f"  Difference: {rec['difference']}")
EOF
uv run --offline --no-sync --project /opt/demo python process_invoices.py
